name: Segment-Domain Treasure Compass
description:
When used within the Temple of Space, this device detects nearby treasures and the related clues.
 Even within the hidden vaults where the thousand winds cannot reach, there are still invisible threads that guide the way toward the most precious of collections — as well as the hidden meanings behind them.
